description: Makes the print-ready files and a mockup that shows exactly what will be printed. Returns a proof id. For a concept from create_design, edit_design or restyle_design the first proof also makes the final full-quality version, so it can take about a minute. With country it also returns the final price including shipping and VAT for that country, shown with the mockup in one card.

country.description: Delivery country, ISO code (NL, DE, US, ...). Pass it whenever you know it: the price comes with the proof.
country.title: Country

language.description: Language of the user for text on the product (calendar months): nl, en, de, fr, es
language.title: Language

options.description: Options as {type: value} from get_product, e.g. {'type_garment_size': 'l', 'colours_garment': 'Black'}
options.title: Options

postcode.description: Postcode or ZIP of the delivery address, when known (some countries need it for the price)
postcode.title: Postcode

state.description: US and Canada only: state or province (NY, CA, ON, BC, ...)
state.title: State

name: create_proof
title: Create print proof
